# Video and animation direction kit

<!-- Generated from canon by scripts/build_derived.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every theme ships as a site, a video, or both. The video works as the site's trailer: the same title treatment, palette and motif as the S1.

## Formats and frame rates

- Masters at 16:9, 1920 x 1080; cutdowns at 9:16 and 1:1. TX-04, TX-10 and TX-12 letterbox to 2.39:1 inside the 16:9 frame.
- 24 fps is the cinematic default. Use 30 fps for broadcast and interface themes (TX-03, TX-05, TX-08, TX-20). TX-18 mixes 24 fps with 12 fps on twos for stylized moves.

## Length templates

| Length | Structure | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 15 s | Hook (0 to 2 s), one stat in the theme's data skin, end card | Social teaser, ad |
| 30 s | Hook, title card, 2 beats, end card | Launch post, event promo |
| 60 to 90 s | Cold open, title card, 3 beats, resolve, end card | Site trailer, keynote opener |

## Shared rules

- Title cards and lower thirds use the card's display and mono faces.
- Pacing follows the card's BPM range. Cut on downbeats unless the card calls for holds (TX-12, TX-15, TX-20).
- Audio is original or a properly licensed library track matching the card's sound bed. No sound-alikes of franchise themes. A public-domain composition still needs a licensed or original recording.
- Captions are burned in on social cutdowns, with an SRT alongside every master.
- Flash testing: any cut with flicker, glitch, strobe or fast light changes is tested before publishing, with the free PEAT tool from the Trace R&D Center for web and social, or a commercial flash test for broadcast and paid media.
- Manifest parity: a video gets the same manifest lines as a site: theme, intensity, homage-check, audio license, flash-test result.

## Every card's video grammar

| Theme | Video |
| --- | --- |
| [TX-01 VECTOR GRID](../themes/tx-01-vector-grid.md) | Cold open riding the grid at speed, cuts on 90° turns landing on downbeats, titles wiring in line by line. Arpeggiated synth with a sub pulse, 100 to 120 BPM. |
| [TX-02 PHOSPHOR RAIN](../themes/tx-02-phosphor-rain.md) | Black frame with a blinking cursor, rain resolving into the title, green "inside" scenes cut against steel-blue "outside" scenes, a freeze-orbit shot for the key stat. Low industrial pulse with glitch percussion, 90 to 100 BPM. |
| [TX-03 GLASS HUD](../themes/tx-03-glass-hud.md) | Camera pushes through glass layers toward the subject; callouts track to it; panel wipes. Low synth bed, 80 to 90 BPM, sparse UI chirps (video only; web stays silent). |
| [TX-04 RAINLIGHT NOIR](../themes/tx-04-rainlight-noir.md) | Long takes, slow push-ins, reflections, silhouettes against haze, 2.39:1 letterbox. Lush analog brass pads and long reverb, 60 to 80 BPM or free time. |
| [TX-05 STUTTER BROADCAST](../themes/tx-05-stutter-broadcast.md) | News-desk framing, a presenter cut off by interruptions, stutter edits on the beat, interlace artifacts, a 4:3 frame inside 16:9. Synth-pop at 110 to 120 BPM, chopped vocal stabs (original), short static stings. |
| [TX-06 OTHERSIDE ’83](../themes/tx-06-otherside-83.md) | A slow push on the title, analog synth arpeggios at 80 to 100 BPM, dissolves, practical-light flicker under 3 per second. |
| [TX-07 NIGHT DRIVE](../themes/tx-07-night-drive.md) | Passing lights through a car window, mirror framing with no identifiable car, script title cards, synthwave at 85 to 118 BPM with gated-reverb drums. |
| [TX-08 COLD STORAGE](../themes/tx-08-cold-storage.md) | Slow pans across instrument panels, blinking lights, long silences. Ship hum and relay clicks; no score, or a sparse drone. |
| [TX-09 SPACE OPERA](../themes/tx-09-space-opera.md) | Crawl, then tilt down to a planet; wipes between scenes; orchestral brass with a short original motif per faction or competitor. |
| [TX-10 SANDSCALE](../themes/tx-10-sandscale.md) | Extreme wides, slow pushes, silhouettes on ridgelines, long holds. Sub-bass drones and low choral textures. |
| [TX-11 WASTELAND CHROME](../themes/tx-11-wasteland-chrome.md) | Rapid cutting with centered eye-trace, an orange-teal grade, speed ramps, war-drum percussion at 140 BPM or faster. |
| [TX-12 SLIT-SCAN COSMOS](../themes/tx-12-slit-scan-cosmos.md) | Long static frames, intermission cards, organ or orchestral textures. A public-domain composition still needs a licensed or original recording. |
| [TX-13 CLOCKWORK REALM](../themes/tx-13-clockwork-realm.md) | An overhead glide across the map while structures assemble; an original cello ostinato at 90 to 110 BPM. |
| [TX-14 RED-LINE EXPEDITION](../themes/tx-14-red-line-expedition.md) | A map-travel montage dissolving into "on location" scenes; original adventure brass and strings at 100 to 120 BPM. |
| [TX-15 PAINTED WIND](../themes/tx-15-painted-wind.md) | Lingering establishing shots, slow cloud pans, quiet moments, piano and strings in 3/4. |
| [TX-16 PAPER CUT TITLES](../themes/tx-16-paper-cut-titles.md) | Title-sequence grammar: every cut on the beat, shapes morphing into the next frame, original swing jazz with brass stabs at 120 to 140 BPM. |
| [TX-17 SILHOUETTE & SMOKE](../themes/tx-17-silhouette-smoke.md) | Slow-motion liquids, silhouettes, mirrored frames, and an original orchestral ballad feel with brass. |
| [TX-18 HALFTONE MULTIVERSE](../themes/tx-18-halftone-multiverse.md) | Mixed frame rates (24 and 12), split screens, sound-effect words on hits, misregistration on cuts. |
| [TX-19 SYMMETRY DIORAMA](../themes/tx-19-symmetry-diorama.md) | Symmetrical frames, lateral dollies, snap zooms, chapter cards, original chamber-pop plucked strings at 100 to 120 BPM. |
| [TX-20 LIMINAL OFFICE](../themes/tx-20-liminal-office.md) | Long hallway dollies, symmetrical framing, uneasy synth pads under a warm office-music bed. |
